title: 第21章 极阴服用血气丹第22章 极阴之死
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
宋文盘腿坐好，调整呼吸，片刻之后，才将丹药送入了口中。
丹药入腹，便如同前次一样，化为一股股热流，流遍全身。
他经脉中的灵力在开始暴涨，迅速贯穿四肢百骸，最后归于丹田之中。
同样，他体内的气血开始陡然消耗，好似这丹药的作用是将他体内的气血，化为了灵气。
先前出现过一次的神秘能量，也再次出现，迅速补充了他消耗的气血。
宋文一直想要弄清楚自身肉身的神秘之处，于是一开始就分出了部分心神，用于关注身体的变化。
这次他终于注意到，这神秘力量的来源。
它们竟然来自于身体中各处骨骼的深处，是骨骼中蕴藏的精血释放出来的。
“难道我杀人吞噬的那些精血，被身体吸收消化后，化为了我自身的精血，隐藏在了身体之中？”
“精血乃是一个人的生命之精，事关一个人的健康和寿命，不知道这些精血有没有延长寿命的作用。”
也许是由于宋文吞噬过五人的精血，这次冒出的精血能量要远比上次庞大得多。
这让宋文身体的气血一直处于一个平衡状态，并没有出现明显衰弱的情况。
这让一旁的极阴尤为激动，多年的尝试终于见到成功的曙光了。
正在炼化药力的宋文，却没有极阴那么乐观。
“妈的，怎么回事，这丹药的药力怎么比上次的强了一倍有余？这极阴到底是怎么炼制的丹药，药性如此不稳定。”
“幸好吞噬了苟航三人的精血，要不然还真不一定抗的过去。”
宋文一边默默的炼化药力，一边在心中咒骂。
丹药的药力越强，消耗的气血越多，意味着给宋文转化的灵力也就越多。
在不知不觉之间，宋文的修为竟然突然暴涨，直接突破了练气一层，来到了练气二层。
“成功了！”

极阴兴奋得不能自已，睁大双眼，低声呐呐自语道。
他激动得手都有些颤抖，他想要即刻尝试吞服丹药，来突破困了自己多年的修为瓶颈。
不过，极阴最终还是压下了这种冲动，稳妥起见，他决定还是等宋文完全炼化药力之后，看看情况再做决定。
半个时辰之后，宋文将丹药药力完全炼化，他的修为也稳定在练气二层。
宋文双眼中闪烁着兴奋的目光，像是有劫后余生的庆幸，又有修为突破实力增长的高兴。
“师尊，丹药没问题，我的修为也突破了，”
极阴点了点头，他将手握住宋文的手腕，用灵力探查了一遍宋文的身体。
在他的感知中，宋文的身体没有任何问题，修为也实打实的来到了练气二层。
content_en:
Song Wen sat cross-legged, adjusted his breathing, and after a moment, put the elixir into his mouth.
As soon as the elixir entered the abdomen, it turned into streams of heat and flowed throughout the body, just like the last time.
The spiritual power in his meridians began to surge, quickly penetrated his limbs and bones, and finally returned to his dantian.
Likewise, the qi and blood in his body began to be consumed suddenly, as if the elixir's function was to turn the qi and blood in his body into spiritual energy.
The mysterious energy that had appeared once before also appeared again, quickly replenishing the energy and blood he had consumed.
Song Wen had always wanted to figure out the mystery of his own body, so he set aside part of his mind from the beginning to pay attention to the changes in his body.
This time he finally noticed the source of this mysterious power.
They actually come from the depths of the bones in the body, and are released from the essence and blood contained in the bones.
"Could it be that the blood essence and blood I killed and devoured were absorbed and digested by the body and turned into my own blood essence and blood, hidden in the body?"
"Essence and blood are the essence of a person's life. They are related to a person's health and lifespan. I don't know if these essences and blood can extend lifespan."
Perhaps because Song Wen had devoured the blood essence of five people, the energy of the blood essence emerging this time was much greater than last time.
This kept Song Wen's body's energy and blood in a balanced state, and there was no obvious weakness.
This made Ji Yin on the side particularly excited. After years of trying, he finally saw the dawn of success.
Song Wen, who was refining the medicinal power, was not as optimistic as Ji Yin.
"Damn, what's going on? How come the potency of this pill is more than twice as strong as the last one? How did Ji Yin refine the pill so that its properties are so unstable?"
"Fortunately, I swallowed the essence and blood of Gou Hang and the other three, otherwise I wouldn't have been able to resist."
Song Wen was cursing in his heart while silently refining the potion.
The stronger the medicinal power of the elixir, the more Qi and blood it consumes, which means the more spiritual power can be transformed into Song Wen.
Unknowingly, Song Wen's cultivation level suddenly skyrocketed, directly breaking through the first level of Qi training and reaching the second level of Qi training.
"Success!"
Ji Yin was so excited that he couldn't control himself. He opened his eyes wide and whispered to himself in a low voice.
He was so excited that his hands were shaking. He wanted to try to swallow the pill immediately to break through the bottleneck of his cultivation that had trapped him for many years.
However, Ji Yin finally suppressed this impulse. To be on the safe side, he decided to wait until Song Wen completely refined the potion and then make a decision based on the situation.
Half an hour later, Song Wen had completely refined the power of the elixir, and his cultivation had stabilized at the second level of Qi training.
Song Wen's eyes flashed with excitement, as if he was lucky to survive the disaster, and he was happy to have achieved a breakthrough in his cultivation and increased his strength.
"Master, there is no problem with the elixir, and my cultivation has also made a breakthrough,"
Ji Yin nodded. He held Song Wen's wrist and used his spiritual power to explore Song Wen's body.
In his perception, there was nothing wrong with Song Wen's body, and his cultivation had truly reached the second level of Qi training.
